source: 3D都市モデル（Project PLATEAU）港区・新宿区（2025年度）（東京都）をOpenGraffitiが加工
processing: LOD2/3 planar WallSurface extraction; original UV to padded texture atlases; lazy 2048px wall baking; street-axis fit with building occlusion tests
limitations: Source facade imagery errors cannot be reconstructed from a single aerial image; road visibility is a sampled approximation, no trees/vehicles; LOD2 painted windows are not geometric openings.
